institutions.name: Punjab Agricultural University
institutions.description: Premier agricultural state university pioneering the Green Revolution, producing regional packages of practices for Punjab agro-climatic zones.

institutions.name: Chaudhary Charan Singh Haryana Agricultural University
institutions.description: Leading northern agricultural university specializing in arid, semi-arid, and canal-irrigated cropping systems in Haryana.

institutions.name: ICAR - Indian Institute of Wheat and Barley Research
institutions.description: National apex research institute coordinating All India Coordinated Research Project on Wheat & Barley (AICRPW&B).

institutions.name: ICAR - Central Potato Research Institute
institutions.location: Shimla, Himachal Pradesh & Jalandhar Station, Punjab
institutions.description: National apex potato research body specializing in seed potato technology, late blight epidemiology, and Kufri cultivars.

institutions.name: ICAR - National Rice Research Institute
institutions.description: National research authority on rice pathology, bacterial blight management, and blast genetics.

institutions.name: Krishi Vigyan Kendra Network (Punjab & Haryana)
institutions.location: District-level Agricultural Science Centers across Punjab and Haryana
institutions.description: Frontline agricultural extension network linking laboratory research to individual farm holdings with on-field diagnostic demonstrations.
